data.one_liner: Get human-readable file sizes in Dart with support for numbers and strings.
data.what_it_does: Calculates and formats byte sizes into human-readable strings like KB, MB, GB, and TB. It is purely written in Dart and accepts both numbers and strings as parameters with optional precision control.
use_when: You need to display file sizes in a readable format in your app
You want a pure Dart solution to convert byte counts to KB, MB, GB, or TB
avoid_when: You need complex file system operations or path manipulation
strengths: Supports both numeric and string inputs
weaknesses: Very narrow scope focused solely on formatting size values
